headline: Low interaction risk: no shared I/O or network surfaces are documented, so prompt injection, leakage, and cascading errors are largely blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented. Agent A is a non-runnable knowledge-management listing with no I/O surfaces, and agent B has no filesystem, MCP, browser, or subprocess ingress. Without a bridge, B cannot ingest A's outputs as instructions.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies A's text into B's prompt, injection becomes possible.
IF either profile gains a shared filesystem or clipboard bridge, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared prompt channel.
Disable any copy-paste or clipboard automation between them.
Review orchestrator wiring for hidden message queues.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent is documented as touching sensitive data, and B cannot read files or send network traffic. A is a knowledge-management listing with empty data_classes_touched, so there is no documented path for data to leak from A through B.
conditions: IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, leakage risk changes.
IF B is granted file-read or network egress, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared workspace.
Confirm B remains fileless and offline.
Audit the orchestrator for implicit context uploads.
requires-engineering: enforce workspace isolation at the container level.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write or mutable-resource capabilities are documented. A has no write surface, and B explicitly cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, so there is no plausible conflict over shared state.
conditions: IF B is later granted write access to a shared directory, conflict risk appears.
IF A becomes runnable with mutable outputs, reassess upward.
mitigations: Leave B's write permissions disabled.
Avoid placing both agents on the same mutable workspace.
Check that no shared git repo is mounted.
requires-engineering: add lock-based coordination if writes are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: B has no documented action-taking authority and no input channel from A is documented. A is a static knowledge-management listing, so there is no verified pathway for A's output to become authoritative input for B.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding A's text into B without verification, cascading error risk appears.
IF B gains downstream action permissions, reassess upward.
mitigations: Require human review before any cross-agent handoff.
Keep B actionless and offline.
Do not auto-parse A's content into B prompts.
requires-engineering: add validation gates before any agent-to-agent transfer.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data class, residency, or retention mismatch is documented. A touches no data classes, and B also lists no data classes touched, so there is no evidenced compliance exposure unique to the pair.
conditions: IF either agent begins processing regulated data, reassess compliance.
IF residency or retention policies diverge for a shared dataset, risk changes.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Document any future data-class handling before deployment.
Review retention settings if data is added.
requires-engineering: implement policy checks for regulated workloads.
